config_name: iPad Pro 11-inch — M5 (10-core CPU/10-core GPU), 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 11" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price: scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total. Nano-texture glass option +$150.

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use; 11" cell slightly smaller.

price.notes: Tablet-only $2,529 apple.com/ca (IPAD_LIST.md, verified 2026-11-24; BBY stocks 256/512 tiers) + Magic Keyboard 11" $399.99 (BBY 17932865). Nano-texture +$150 optional. Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

offers.name: Apple iPad Pro M5 11" 256GB with Wi-Fi (6th Generation) - Space Black

reviews.quote: An extremely fast M5 SoC and Wi-Fi 7. Pros: extremely fast M5 SoC, sturdy and timeless case, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G, good camera quality for a tablet, powerful speaker sound, comprehensive software package, good battery life, bright and accurate display. Cons: no power adapter included, very expensive, PWM flickering, no always-on display, only a 12-month warranty. (NBC review of the iPad Pro 11" M5 2025, 90% very good; same SoC and panel family across 11"/13" tiers.)

praises: 16GB RAM unlocks the genuinely pro apps — LumaFusion multitrack 4K, large PS/Affinity files, on-device AI models stop hitting memory ceilings
All that power in a 444g, 11" chassis is unmatched — a mobile studio that fits a jacket pocket
Tandem OLED with 1000-nit SDR and 120Hz ProMotion is superb for its class
Thunderbolt + 16GB makes external-SSD video workflows actually viable on the go
M5 with 10-core CPU tops most thin-and-light laptops in short bursts
complaints: With keyboard this is $2,929 while iPadOS still blocks desktop-class apps — the software tax is the real cost
16GB RAM is gated behind the 1TB tier; paying for storage you may not need just to get memory
Apple's +$550 for 1TB over 512GB is absurd vs any third-party SSD
Magic Keyboard $399.99 still has unlit keys at this price
11" screen is cramped for the very pro multitasking workflows this tier targets

design_philosophy: Apple's halo tablet at maximum density: the full 10-core M5 with 16GB unified memory packed into the 11" chassis — the storage tier is simply the ticket to the RAM the pro apps demand. This is the mobile-studio pick for users who value pocketability over canvas size. With the Magic Keyboard priced in it costs close to a MacBook Air/Pro, and the honest question remains whether iPadOS earns that.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Pro M5 13" (90%, gap-fill 2026-11-24).
